title: Loombridge Slice Plan — .loombridge/SLICES.json
description: The slice contract (plan §'The slice contract'). PRODUCT-OWNED: the product (mcp-server) is the source of truth; individual projects do not author or version this schema. `plan` emits an ordered, dependency-aware DAG of slices for a genre; each slice is built one polished part at a time, verified, and human-approved before the next. The per-slice `proof` block is minted by that slice's `build` (plan §'Per-slice proof model') and never shares a single slot, so prior approvals stay auditable.

genre.description: The genre this slice DAG was instantiated from (e.g. 'platformer-2d').

sliceState.title: Per-slice lifecycle state
sliceState.description: pending → built → verified → approved; `stale` marks a previously-approved slice invalidated by an upstream rebuild (plan §'Dependency invalidation').

proof.title: Per-slice proof block (minted by that slice's build)
proof.description: All fields optional until the slice is built; lives PER SLICE, never in a shared single slot (plan §'Per-slice proof model').

runId.description: Slice-scoped run id, minted at build start (run-<sliceId>-<ts>-<rand>).

startedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the slice build was minted.

captureManifest.description: Paths under .loombridge/verify/<sliceId>/ that MUST exist to certify the slice.

checkpointId.description: The .loombridge-fixtures/<sliceId>/ snapshot id this slice can be re-run from; null until verified.

approvedAt.description: Set at the human checkpoint; null until approved.

approvalNote.description: Optional human/operator approval note recorded at the approval seam.

signoffArtifact.description: Durable root-relative sign-off artifact copied under .loombridge/anchors/signoffs/<sliceId>/.

signoffSha256.description: sha256 of the durable sign-off artifact bytes.

sliceHistoryEntry.title: One recorded lifecycle event on a slice
sliceHistoryEntry.description: Written by `loombridge reopen`, the only sanctioned way to send a settled slice back to `stale`. Before that verb the transition was a hand edit to this file, which left no record it had happened.

action.description: What happened. A CLOSED set: a free-text verb here would be readable only by a human, and a typo would silently become a new event class.

cascade.description: The OTHER slices this event marked stale (transitive dependents). The subject slice is never listed; [] means nothing downstream was touched.

acceptance.title: Slice acceptance — which gates apply to this slice
acceptance.description: The source `verify --slice` reads (plan §'Slice scoping vs --stage'): data-driven gate selection, NOT the hardcoded --stage phase enum.

gates.description: Gate ids this slice's verify must run/pass.

criteria.description: Optional per-slice criteria refinements; deliberately unconstrained here.

id.description: Unique slice id; also names the per-slice verdict/capture/fixture paths.

dependsOn.description: Build order — `plan` walks the DAG to pick the next unblocked slice.

skill.description: OPTIONAL. Which skill pack builds this slice. OMIT when no shipped skill covers it — `plan` then points the agent at the generic ops. Present-but-empty is refused: a blank binding reads as a binding while naming nothing, which is the failure this field's guard exists to stop.

history.description: Append-only lifecycle log. Absent until an event a later reader could not otherwise reconstruct is recorded (today: `loombridge reopen`).
